tip.title: В каком порядке меняются костюмы?
tip.description: Костюмы меняются в том порядке, в котором стоят в списке.

tips.title: In what order do the costumes change?
tips.description: The costumes are changed in the order in which they appear in the list.

hints.text: So that the picture always starts on a clean page, after the start command, set the costume with a blank canvas.
hints.title: Set the right costume at the beginning

hints.text: The first 4 costumes change every second, and it seems like a drawing appears on the canvas. Think about how to do it.
hints.title: Changing costumes every second

tutorial.text: Add an appropriate background and delete the one that is currently in place.

presentation.text: The picture should start on a clean page. And only then does it change costumes when adding a drawing.
presentation.title: Draw a picture

tip.title: В каком порядке меняются фоны?
tip.description: Фоны меняются в том порядке, в котором стоят в списке.

tips.title: In what order do the backgrounds change?
tips.description: The backgrounds change in the order in which they appear in the list.

hints.text: The penguin begins its journey from Antarctica — this particular background should be the first.
hints.title: The first background - "Antarctica"

hints.text: While the "Antarctica" background is on, the penguin takes "steps," meaning it changes its costume. After several costume changes, the background changes.
hints.title: Change of costume and background

tutorial.text: Add an appropriate background and delete the one that is currently in place.

presentation.text: The penguin is going on a journey! And it's beginning its journey from its native Antarctica.
presentation.title: Penguin coming from Antarctica

tip.title: Спрятан ли спрайт?
tip.description: Вот здесь можно посмотреть, спрятан ли спрайт, и вручную его спрятать или показать.

tips.title: Is the sprite hidden?
tips.description: Here you can see if the sprite is hidden and manually hide or show it.

hints.text: The Show command makes the sprite visible.
hints.title: Emerging

hints.text: Before disappearing, the sorceress says that she wants to drink the potion.
hints.title: The sorceress drinks the potion

hints.text: The Hide command makes the sprite invisible.
hints.title: Disappearing

tutorial.text: Add an appropriate background and delete the one that is currently in place.

presentation.text: The sorceress appears, drinks the potion, and disappears.
presentation.title: Disappearing potion

tip.title: Размер спрайта
tip.description: Здесь можно узнать, какой размер спрайта сейчас, а также изменить его вручную.

tips.title: Sprite size
tips.description: Here you can find out what size the sprite is now and also manually change it.

hints.text: Before shrinking, the wizard says he will drink the potion.
hints.title: Drinking the potion

hints.text: Use this command to abruptly resize something.

hints.text: Set the desired size of the wizard at the beginning of the script

presentation.text: The wizard shrank under the influence of the potion. But if you run the project again, the wizard returns to his normal size!
presentation.title: Sorceress and teacher

hints.text: To make it seem like the pterodactyl is flying closer, we need to increase its size and change the costume. And we need to repeat that several times. Add a command that will repeat these steps.

hints.text: The wizard says two phrases, between each of which he is silent for 1 second. And then he disappears.
hints.title: What the wizard does
